describe: Machine-readable sources and availability rules for observables named in the research maps. A binding says when a value became knowable; it makes no claim about what the value means.

series.label: Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), daily close
series.basis_note: Close time: Cboe's VIX methodology gives regular-hours calculation from 8:30 a.m. to 3:15 p.m. Chicago time. The 15-minute delay is an assumption, not sourced. Shortened holiday sessions close earlier, so this rule is conservative on those days.

series.label: Cboe 3-Month Volatility Index (VIX3M), daily close
series.basis_note: Close time assumed equal to the VIX's; no Cboe document confirming VIX3M hours was opened. The 15-minute delay is an assumption, not sourced.

series.label: TSM daily open, regular session
series.basis_note: Session opens at 9:30 a.m. Eastern (NYSE core session hours). The one-minute delay is an assumption. Yahoo is an aggregator, not the exchange: values are restated on the current split basis after every split and exclude dividends.

series.label: TSM daily close, regular session
series.basis_note: Session closes at 4:00 p.m. Eastern (NYSE core session hours), earlier on the two half days. The 15-minute delay is an assumption. Yahoo is an aggregator, not the exchange: values are restated on the current split basis after every split and exclude dividends.

series.label: SOXX daily open, regular session
series.basis_note: Session opens at 9:30 a.m. Eastern (NYSE core session hours). The one-minute delay is an assumption. Yahoo is an aggregator, not the exchange: values are restated on the current split basis after every split and exclude dividends.

series.label: SOXX daily close, regular session
series.basis_note: US regular session close, with an assumed 15-minute publication delay. The rule is conservative on shortened sessions. Yahoo history uses the snapshot's split basis and excludes dividends. Earlier vintages may differ.

events.label: TSMC monthly revenue report
events.timestamp_source: SEC EDGAR acceptance time of the Form 6-K carrying the report
events.basis_note: The report is released in Taiwan first and carries a date but no time. The 6-K acceptance time is provable but later than the true release, so it is an upper bound: using it may admit observations that became available after the real announcement. Replace with the Taiwan disclosure timestamp when one is recorded.
